items.name: Marsh
items.headline: Q3 adjusted EPS up 10% as Consulting outgrows insurance broking
items.catalyst: Marsh reported Q3 revenue of $6.863 billion versus $6.351 billion a year earlier, GAAP EPS of $1.69 versus $1.51, and 5% underlying revenue growth.
items.thesis: The mix is the story: Consulting grew 8% on an underlying basis while Risk & Insurance Services managed 3%, a sign that growth on the broking side has cooled. Buybacks of $2.0 billion year to date add support to per-share growth.

items.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.headline: Q3 revenue up 50.9%; Q4 guided to $52.3B–$54.3B
items.catalyst: TSMC reported Q3 revenue of NT$1,494.24 billion (US$46.72 billion), up 50.9% in NT$ terms, with diluted EPS up 68.7% to NT$29.43, and guided Q4 revenue to US$52.3 billion to US$54.3 billion.
items.thesis: The numbers confirm leading-edge demand is still growing strongly, with 3nm and 5nm at 61% of wafer revenue and a 2nm ramp ahead. With expectations already high across AI hardware, trading reaction is likely to hinge on margins and capex commentary rather than the beat itself.
items.correction: Clarified that 50.9% growth is in NT$ terms and replaced 'still accelerating' since guided Q4 sequential growth (+14.1%) is below Q3's 16.2%.

items.name: PNC Financial Services
items.headline: Q3 EPS of $4.97 as net interest income rises 15%
items.catalyst: PNC earned $2.10 billion, or $4.97 a diluted share ($5.09 adjusted), versus $4.35 a year earlier, on revenue of $6.56 billion; net interest income rose 15% while noninterest income fell 15% from Q2.
items.thesis: Spread income is carrying results while capital markets revenue cooled sequentially. Rising net charge-offs and a lower CET1 ratio are the details investors are likely to weigh against the earnings growth.
items.source_name: PNC Financial Services Group, Q3 2026 earnings release

items.name: U.S. Bancorp
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises to $1.34 on fee growth and better efficiency
items.catalyst: U.S. Bancorp's Q3 net income rose to $2.20 billion, or $1.34 a diluted share, from $1.22, with noninterest income up 13.1% and the efficiency ratio at 55.9% versus 57.2%.
items.thesis: Fee momentum and improving efficiency are the positive read, while the $135 million initial provision for an acquired card book is a one-time accounting item. Zero buybacks in the quarter keeps the capital return question open.

items.name: BNY
items.headline: Q3 EPS climbs 24% as fees and net interest income both grow
items.catalyst: BNY reported Q3 revenue of $5.68 billion, up 12%, and diluted EPS of $2.34 versus $1.88, with assets under custody and/or administration of $63.4 trillion.
items.thesis: Double-digit growth in both fees and net interest income with a 38.5% pre-tax margin shows the custody franchise is generating operating leverage. The 10.9% CET1 ratio is down from 11.7% a year earlier and 11.0% at June 30.
items.correction: Specified that the 11.7% CET1 comparison is year-ago (11.0% at June 30) and removed the unsupported attribution to capital return; BNY attributes the decline to lower capital.

items.name: Ericsson
items.headline: Organic sales grow 7% in Q3
items.catalyst: Ericsson reported Q3 net sales of SEK 59.5 billion versus SEK 56.2 billion, organic growth of 7% led by Networks, and diluted EPS of SEK 1.77 versus SEK 3.33, which included a SEK 1.72 divestment gain.
items.thesis: A return to organic growth in a RAN market the company calls flat suggests share and commercial actions are working. The flagged component-cost headwind to next year's gross margin is the offsetting risk.
items.source_name: Ericsson Q3 2026 report (company release via PR Newswire)
items.correction: Changed headline from 'return to 7% growth' to 'grow 7%', as the release does not describe a return to growth.

items.name: Rocket Lab
items.headline: Neutron's inaugural launch now expected in 2027
items.catalyst: Rocket Lab said after the Oct. 14 close that Neutron's inaugural launch is now expected to occur in 2027 under an adjusted schedule.
items.thesis: A schedule slip on a flagship development program pushes out a milestone investors have been tracking closely. The absence of a stated reason in the release leaves investors to the accompanying presentation for detail.
items.source_name: Rocket Lab investor relations release, Oct. 14, 2026
